def merge_sorted(a, b):
    """Merge two sorted lists into a new sorted list.
    Does not modify inputs. Runs in O(len(a) + len(b)) time.
    """
    i = j = 0
    merged = []
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        if a[i] <= b[j]:
            merged.append(a[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            merged.append(b[j])
            j += 1
    merged.extend(a[i:])
